ValidationRule.description: WayBill number is required for complaint type cases.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Custom_Validation_Exception_Setting__c.Bypass_Validation_Rules__c), AND( TEXT(Origin) != 'WhatsApp', TEXT(Origin) != 'WEB' ), TEXT(Case_Nature__c) = 'Complaint', OR(ISBLANK(WaybillNo__c),ISNULL(WaybillNo__c)), OR(TEXT(Case_Type__c) ='Service Issue', TEXT(Case_Type__c) ='Escalation', TEXT(Case_Type__c) ='Freight Dispute' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Waybill Number is mandatory for complaint cases with the given case type.
